subject: Gen7 current-round Manager reconciliation V1: converged V2 correction set; Core V1 remains NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE
body: Current main rechecked unchanged at 633c75be26001d5a4ef6e04c7696e8246713be44. Manager reconciliation across completed Gen7 Core V1 handoffs shows strong independent convergence. Overall Core V1 disposition remains NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE / revision-required, not architectural rejection. READY_FOR_PRIMARY as correction contracts: (A) on trusted-geometry reacquisition, invalidate pre-gap direction continuity before reversal evaluation; the first post-gap segment cannot itself prove reversal; (B) reacquisition exit must be residual/error gated and cadence-stable, with error-shaped/critically-damped correction and explicit acceleration/jerk bounds; numeric damping constants remain MODEL-only pending Fold7 tuning; (C) freshness/confidence must use trusted source age at target presentation in one normalized monotonic clock domain, while delivery age remains transport diagnostics; Android integration must adapt SensorEvent and FrameTimeline clocks explicitly; (D) causal identity must carry exact attempt + current generation + host/resource identity through frame, receipt, migration and refresh events; stale/nonmonotonic callbacks must be rejected rather than merely clamped; (E) refresh leases must not silently overwrite active votes, must be host/resource scoped for make-before-break coexistence, seamless-only by invariant, and release-all on terminal/supersession; requested Hz is never evidence of delivered cadence; (F) diagnostics should preserve timestamped acquire/observe/release and exact current generation rather than silent active-attempt replacement. NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE/blocking before migration readiness promotion: the current receipt ledger can skip FIRST_PRESENTED, accept post-generation/post-terminal readiness, regress timestamps, overwrite first-receipt history, and then retire outgoing host; a hardened exact-current receipt oracle/final handoff is still pending, and the final FIRST_USEFUL semantic oracle remains undefined. Additional active lanes still pending: renderer direct visualProgress cutover, private/protected provenance, adaptive profile gating; actual Fold7 120Hz/privacy/useful-presentation proof remains FIELD unknown. Integrity drift in BETA_ENTRY_DIRECTIVE_V2 is separately quarantined from authority because discovery-v4 excludes it; exact canonical repair awaits Primary DEC/quorum. No production writes.
